summary: Aditxt, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Note Purchase Agreement on June 3, 2026, with Ignite Proteomics LLC and named investors. The agreement involves issuing senior secured convertible notes with an aggregate principal amount of $725,000 cash plus outstanding obligations under Existing Notes, subject to a 35% original issue discount. Existing March Notes ($3,194,444) and April Notes ($1,250,000) are consolidated. Ignite granted a security interest in substantially all its assets, and Aditxt pledged its equity in Ignite as collateral. This is a distressed refinancing/note restructuring, not a standard special situation. What to watch: conversion terms and potential dilution.
